scripts.dev: echo "run 'pnpm dev-server' in the root directory instead" >&2 && exit 1
scripts.build:worker: node build-browser-runtime.mjs && pnpm exec capnweb-validate build --out .wrangler/validate
scripts.test: node build-browser-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-format-blueprints.mjs && vp test run
scripts.test:integration: node build-browser-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-format-blueprints.mjs && vp test run --project integration
scripts.test:watch: node build-browser-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-format-blueprints.mjs && vp test
